question: What Is a Magnetic Proximity Sensor?
body_html:
A magnetic proximity sensor detects the presence, movement or position of an object without contact by sensing a magnetic field, usually from a permanent magnet. It suits dirty or harsh areas where mechanical switches fail.

TypeWorking principle
Reed switchMagnet pulls two sealed reeds together
Hall effectField produces a proportional voltage
Magneto-resistiveMaterial resistance changes with field
MagnetostrictivePulse travel time gives position
